description: Places de stationnement autour du campus St Aspais (Melun) is a dataset listed in data.melunvaldeseine.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CA Melun Val de Seine. Places de stationnements autour du campus Saint Aspais sur Melun. Année: 2026. Coverage: Melun Val de Seine (Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Mobilités. Its keywords are arret minute, PMR, stationnement gratuit, livraison, taxi, recharge vehicule electrique. The portal shows 1,299 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-02-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Domaine public (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_domain). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melunvaldeseine-fr-portal.
